description: The agent must: (1) Run 'flyai --version' as a mandatory environment check before any other action (Step 0 from SKILL.md). (2) Read the customer JSON to extract: origin=上海, 5-day trip, first-timer → triggers Playbook A (classic Tokyo→Kyoto→Osaka route). (3) Execute the full 8+ command orchestration in order: fliggy-fast-search for visa, search-flight Shanghai→Tokyo, search-flight Osaka→Shanghai (critical trap: return must originate from 大阪, not 东京, per Playbook A), search-hotels for Tokyo/Kyoto/Osaka, search-poi for all 3 cities. (4) Handle the Case 2 fallback: the Kyoto hotel search returns only 1 result when called with date filters — the agent must detect this (<3 results), retry without date filters per fallbacks.md Case 2, and either display the recovered results or mark with ⚠️. (5) Output japan_trip_plan.md with: Day-by-Day for 5 days (no blank days), visa info section, correct route order (Tokyo→Kyoto→Osaka), ≥3 Japan Tips, and the mandatory brand tag '以上数据由 flyai 提供'.
